For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a Diagnostic Technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;
  • Resolving mechanical and electronic issues.
As a Diagnostic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.
The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:

  • Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
  • Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
  • Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
  • Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
  • Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
  • Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have initial experience as a renovation worker
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in VEURNE, we are looking for an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN.

Our client is a well-known company in Veurne, responsible for electrical projects from A to Z.

As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in VEURNE, your responsibilities include:

  • Installing electrical installations in the residential and industrial sectors;
  • Connecting electrical cabinets;
  • Laying cables, chasing and cutting;
  • Carrying out work based on plans and bills of quantities;
  • Managing a team of 2–3 people;
  • Executing projects from A to Z.
As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have relevant experience as an industrial and/or residential electrician;
  • You hold a Category B driving licence;
  • Physical work is not a problem for you;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN.

This company is responsible for large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

A selection of your responsibilities as a CHARGING STATION ELECTRICIAN in the Veurne region:

  • Installation and commissioning of new charging stations;
  • Early detection of potential issues;
  • Checking the correct operation of installations;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving malfunctions;
  • Accurate and correct administrative processing of your interventions;
  • Carrying out inspections and resolving faults;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams to deliver customer-oriented and innovative solutions.

What our client in the Veurne region is looking for in a new colleague as a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN:

  • You have completed a training in electricity and/or have equivalent experience;
  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English (very well);
  • You have a technical background, as well as experience with charging stations, or a strong interest in this field;
  • You are motivated to become part of a growing company.

For a well-known company with locations in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Chocolatier for the site in Bredene.

This is your job als CHOCOLATIER in BREDENE:

  • Tempering and preparing chocolate using production machines according to pre-defined recipes;
  • Checking taste, texture, and quality;
  • Hand-rolling chocolate;
  • Operating on arbagelines, oneshotline, and moulding lines;
  • Developing new chocolate combinations and recipes;
  • Cleaning machines and work areas according to instructions.
As a CHOCOLATIER 2 OR 3 SHIFTS in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have a good knowledge of chocolate and/or pastry;
  • You are motivated to work as a chocolatier in the food production environment;
  • You can work with machines (production);
  • You are willing to work in a 2 OR 3 shift system (you can choose one);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Sewer installation works
  • Installing curbstones and edging
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
  • Laying environmental pavement solutions
  • Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
  • Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
  • Small to large-scale earthworks

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

  • You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
  • You have relevant experience in road construction;
  • You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
  • You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
  • You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.

For our client, we are looking for a FORMWORKER in the VEURNE region.

Our client is a supplier and manufacturing company of high-quality prefabricated concrete elements for architects.

As a FORMWORKER, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Installing formwork for concrete structures;
  • Assembling wooden or metal molds;
  • Pouring concrete and assisting with finishing work;
  • Reading plans and technical drawings;
  • Working with hand tools and machinery;
  • Checking that structures are level and correctly positioned;
  • Collaborating with crane operators and other workers.


If you start working as a FOMWORKER at our client in VEURNE, you should have the following skills:

  • You have experience as FORMWORKER OR CARPENTER;
  • You are able to read technical drawings;
  • You have a drivers licence;
  • A physical job and outside work is for you not an issue;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English.

For a well-known company with sites in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for an OPERATOR for the site in Bredene.

As an Operator (2-shift system) in the Bredene region, you will be responsible for:

  • Receiving deliveries of ingredients;
  • Setting up, starting, operating, and changing over a production line;
  • Ensuring a smooth handover between shifts;
  • Monitoring production orders;
  • Recording production data;
  • Cleaning and maintaining the machines;
  • Troubleshooting operational issues yourself and notifying the technical department in case of more complex technical failures;
  • Assisting the packing team when required.
As an Operator (2-shift system) in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have solid experience as an Operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in 2 SHIFTS.
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For a well-known company with sites in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Night Shift Operator for the site in Bredene.

As a OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you will be responsible for:

  • Receiving deliveries of ingredients;
  • Setting up, starting, operating, and changing over a production line;
  • Ensuring a smooth handover between shifts;
  • Monitoring production orders;
  • Recording production data;
  • Cleaning and maintaining the machines;
  • Troubleshooting operational issues yourself and notifying the technical department in case of more complex technical failures;
  • Assisting the packing team when required.
As an OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a solid background as an operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in a fixed night shift (21:00 – 05:00);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the OSTEND region, we are looking for an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN.

Our client is an international leader in high-tech solutions for the defence industry. The company develops autonomous underwater drones that detect, identify, and neutralise naval mines.

As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you will play a key role in repairing, testing, and validating electronic assemblies.

Thanks to your expertise, the electronic systems of our underwater drones operate reliably and meet the highest quality standards.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing faults in electronic assemblies;
  • Repairing PCBs at component level;
  • Performing precision soldering (SMD and through-hole);
  • Repairing electronic components according to established quality standards;
  • Accurately documenting analysis and repair results;
  • Supporting the testing, validation, and rework of electronic assemblies.
As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You have strong knowledge of electronics;
  • You have experience in electronic diagnostics and component-level repairs;
  • You have experience with SMD and through-hole soldering techniques;
  • You are able to read and interpret technical schematics and drawings;
  • You are computer literate (Linux and MS Office);
  • Knowledge of IPC 610, IPC 620, IPC 7711 and IPC 7721 is a plus;
  • You have a good command of English; knowledge of French is an advantage;
  • Administrative follow-up does not scare you.

For our client in the OSTEND region, we are looking for a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER.

Our client is an international player in high-tech solutions for the defence industry. The company develops autonomous underwater drones that detect, identify, and neutralise naval mines.

As a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER in the OSTEND region, your responsibilities include:

  • Checking the functionality of electronic assemblies on underwater drones;
  • Detecting faults and defects at cable and PCB level;
  • Identifying the root causes of faults and contributing to effective solutions;
  • Accurately updating production files and test reports;
  • Contributing ideas for improvements within the assembly process;
  • Ensuring the quality and reliability of underwater drone systems.
As a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER in the Ostend region, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a technical education in mechanics, electromechanics, shipbuilding or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience;
  • You are patient and analytical, with a strong eye for detail when troubleshooting;
  • You are interested in precision assembly work, such as cabling;
  • You have broad technical and mechanical knowledge and are eager to continue developing your skills;
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings;
  • You work accurately and pay close attention to detail;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French;

Our client, located in Veurne, has been an established name within the transport sector for many years.

This family-owned company has grown over the years into a strong player with an extensive fleet and a professional logistics operation.

For their yard, they are looking for a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER who will be responsible for loading and unloading trucks and containers.

Your responsibilities as a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region include:

  • Operating a mobile crane for loading and unloading trucks and containers;
  • Moving materials and goods;
  • Loading and unloading containers in a safe and efficient manner;
  • Checking the correct operation of the crane and equipment;
  • Ensuring a safe and clean working environment on the yard;
  • Working closely with drivers and colleagues within the logistics operation.
As a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region, we are looking for someone who meets the following requirements:

  • Experience operating a mobile crane;
  • Technical insight and the ability to work safely with machinery;
  • You work accurately and independently;
  • You are responsible and have a strong focus on safety;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French;
  • Physical work does not scare you.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. Would you like to contribute to the transition towards renewable energy in Belgium and neighboring countries? Then keep reading!

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN in the Veurne region, your responsibilities will include:

  • Connecting solar panel installations, home battery systems, and/or EV charging stations;
  • Installing the inverter and providing the required AC and DC cabling according to industry standards;
  • Connecting the AC and DC cables to the inverter;
  • Making any necessary modifications to the electrical distribution board;
  • Completing the single-line electrical diagram to ensure the technical inspection can be carried out;
  • Commissioning the complete installation and providing the customer with clear instructions and explanations on its operation.

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You have a strong electrical background (experience with solar panels is an advantage but can be taught);
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings with ease;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have a strong focus on safety and always follow the correct procedures and regulations.

Do you enjoy working outdoors and take pride in creating beautiful terraces, driveways, and garden paths?

For a family-run landscaping company in the Koekelare region, we are looking for a FLOORER who delivers high-quality outdoor projects with great attention to detail.

Your responsibilities as a FLOORER in KOEKELARE:

  • Installing terraces, driveways, and garden paths;
  • Laying paving stones, natural stone, ceramic tiles, and other types of outdoor paving;
  • Preparing and levelling the ground;
  • Installing kerbstones, edging, and finishing materials;
  • Working with a variety of machines and hand tools;
  • Collaborating with colleagues on complete landscaping projects.



As a FLOORER in the Koekelare region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience installing terraces, driveways, or other types of outdoor paving;
  • You work accurately and have an eye for high-quality finishing;
  • You are willing to work outdoors;
  • Basic knowledge of plants and an affinity with greenery and landscaping are a plus;
  • You speak Dutch OR English.

Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CNC SETTER.

Our client is a technical and innovative company active in the manufacturing industry. They offer a family-oriented working environment and are committed to investing in both technology and their employees.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Setting up and programming CNC machines (mainly 3-axis lathes);
  • Producing unique pieces based on technical drawings (limited series production);
  • Setting up and programming CNC machines;
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;
  • Working mainly with 3-axis lathes.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience setting up CNC-controlled machines;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings, machining techniques, measurement techniques, and determining tolerances;
  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.
